title: tham kar apni kamar shey ne sada di abbas
body:
tham kar apni kamar shey ne sada di abbas
aye alamdar-e-jari aye mere bhai abbas
1.haath katne pe bhi seene se tha mashikza laga
bole shey khoob wafa tum ne nibhai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
2.ab na akbar sa jawan la’al na humdum koi
tumsa saathi nahi yawar nahi ghazi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
3.nehr thi zere khadam tum rahi pyaase phir bhi
hashr tak teri wafa yaad rahegi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
4.jaan ko khuwaaish-e-baba nichawar karke
aabroo haq-e-niyabath ki bachayi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
5.kya kahun jaake sakina se kaha sarwar ne
kya qayamath ki ghadi mujh pe ye aayi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
6.laash pe hazrath-e-abbas ki shey kehte the
mujhko tadpayegi ab teri judai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
7.hyderi sher ho maskan bhi tarai payi
khoob sone ki jagah tumne hai paayi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
8.jab lahad nanhi si ek maine banai run mein
yaad us waqt mujhe teri hai aayi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
9.dekh kar sher ko aate huwe apni jaanib
chodh kar bhaage layeen pal mein tarai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
10.kis khadar zulm sahe tum ko bataun kya kya
aaj aada ne kamar todi hai bhai abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
11.shah kehte the basad aaho fughan yeh sarwath
kaun ab lega khabar aye mere bhai abbas
